parts.title: Using less waste
questions: What do you do with things you no longer use?
Have you ever borrowed an item instead of buying it?
Are there places near you that accept second-hand goods?
Which items are easiest for you to reuse?

parts.title: Individual talk
parts.cue: Describe a change you made to avoid wasting something.
questions: Explain why you decided to make a change.
Describe what you did and how often.
Explain what made the change easy or difficult to keep up.

parts.title: Discussion
questions: What makes reuse schemes convenient for different groups?
Can a small deposit encourage useful behaviour without creating barriers?
Why should a programme count what people actually reuse as well as what they return?
Which decisions about waste are better made by organisations than by individuals?
